purpose: Gap-ranked task structures for one jurisdiction-neutral algebra core that can later map to Ontario, Maryland, Virginia and DC.

sources.observation_scope: Public catalog organization and task-demand variety only
Public topic catalog and input-variation patterns only
Public topic catalog and generated-exercise categories only
Public marketplace listing categories only; no paid material accessed

ranked_structures.variability: Signed coefficients; integer/fractional constants; operation choice; variable on either side; nonzero coefficient guard.
ranked_structures.cognitive_transition: conceptual equality model → connected procedure → justification transfer
ranked_structures.mihur_scenario: Predict a legal first move, apply it to both balance pans, narrate why equality is preserved, then solve symbolically.
ranked_structures.accessible_mve: Two-pan balance plus a nonvisual before/operation/after transformation table.
ranked_structures.generator_oracle: Deterministic exact-rational linear coefficients; independent Fraction solution and substitution oracle.
ranked_structures.misconception_repair: Route one-sided-operation evidence to a balance replay and a different exit equation.
ranked_structures.unseen_transfer: Construct a rate or perimeter equation and justify each equality-preserving change.

ranked_structures.variability: Negative/positive outside factor; signed inner terms; outside constant; rational solution; partial-distribution distractor.
ranked_structures.cognitive_transition: area/scale meaning → signed products → equation solving
ranked_structures.mihur_scenario: Pair the factor with every inner term, predict signs, compare a near-miss, then solve and substitution-check.
ranked_structures.accessible_mve: Keyboard-selectable term-factor pairs with textual product table and discrete expansion states.
ranked_structures.generator_oracle: Seeded signed factors; independent expansion and exact linear solution oracle.
ranked_structures.misconception_repair: Separate missed-term evidence from dropped-negative evidence; use different probes and exits.
ranked_structures.unseen_transfer: Reject a false expansion embedded in a rectangle-cost model before solving.

ranked_structures.variability: Nonzero scale factors including negatives; reordered sides; valid simplification; one-term and one-side near-misses.
ranked_structures.cognitive_transition: recognize preservation → justify common operation → construct an equivalent equation
ranked_structures.mihur_scenario: Compare four transformations, identify the common operation, and verify with the original exact solution.
ranked_structures.accessible_mve: Equation-pair table with keyboard choice and screen-reader descriptions of term-level changes.
ranked_structures.generator_oracle: Seeded base equation and nonzero scale; independent proportional-coefficient equivalence check.
ranked_structures.misconception_repair: False-equivalence branch highlights unmatched terms without revealing the correct option.
ranked_structures.unseen_transfer: Create one equivalent equation and one plausible non-equivalent near-miss.

ranked_structures.variability: Perfect/nonperfect radicands; principal root prompts; x^2=a with ±; odd roots; negative/no-real radicands; radical isolation.
ranked_structures.cognitive_transition: root as number → inverse operation → complete equation solution set
ranked_structures.mihur_scenario: Contrast the principal square-root symbol with all values satisfying a squared equation, then test candidates.
ranked_structures.accessible_mve: Number-line candidate tester with exact symbolic table; no animation required.
ranked_structures.generator_oracle: Seeded radicand classes; independent exact integer/surd/empty-set oracle.
ranked_structures.misconception_repair: Lost-± and negative-radicand branches use separate candidate-substitution probes.
ranked_structures.unseen_transfer: Determine all real dimensions satisfying an area constraint and reject invalid contextual roots.

ranked_structures.variability: Two-to-four polynomial terms; signed coefficients; multivariable exponents; exact coefficient quotients; residual fractions.
ranked_structures.cognitive_transition: area/factor decomposition → termwise quotient → symbolic law
ranked_structures.mihur_scenario: Partition every polynomial term into equal monomial groups, record each quotient, then recombine and multiply-check.
ranked_structures.accessible_mve: Algebra-tile/grouping table with divisor, each dividend term, quotient term and recomposition.
ranked_structures.generator_oracle: Seeded exponent vectors and rational coefficients; independent multiply-back oracle.
ranked_structures.misconception_repair: Dropped-term, coefficient-only and exponent-addition errors route to distinct recomposition checks.
ranked_structures.unseen_transfer: Recover a missing side expression from a rectangle area and monomial side length.

ranked_structures.variability: Numeric zero; variable monomial divisor; cancelled factor; negative exponent; multiple restricted variables.
ranked_structures.cognitive_transition: division meaning → nonzero condition → equivalent expression on a restricted domain
ranked_structures.mihur_scenario: Predict when grouping is impossible, simplify on the valid domain, then test the excluded input separately.
ranked_structures.accessible_mve: Domain ledger listing original denominator, exclusions and simplified expression.
ranked_structures.generator_oracle: Exact symbolic exponent vector plus explicit excluded-value set.
ranked_structures.misconception_repair: Cancelled-factor misconception requires evaluating original and simplified forms at an excluded input.
ranked_structures.unseen_transfer: Explain why a compact formula and expanded formula agree except at an excluded measurement.

ranked_structures.variability: Power-of-power/product/quotient; zero/negative exponents; numeric and variable bases; nonzero-base guard.
ranked_structures.cognitive_transition: repeated factors → grouped powers → generalized exponent law
ranked_structures.mihur_scenario: Expand a small factor model, predict the exponent rule, compress it, then compare two forms structurally.
ranked_structures.accessible_mve: Keyboard factor-group organizer with textual base/exponent ledger.
ranked_structures.generator_oracle: Seeded exponent tuples; independent normalized exponent-vector oracle.
ranked_structures.misconception_repair: Add-versus-multiply-exponents and distribute-exponent-to-one-factor errors receive different factor counts.
ranked_structures.unseen_transfer: Rewrite a geometry-derived power expression to a required base and defend equivalence.

ranked_structures.canonical_family: Exponent and geometry families as reporting-only combination
ranked_structures.variability: Square/cube dimensions; exponent side lengths; surface area/volume; Pythagorean square areas; unit scaling.
ranked_structures.cognitive_transition: physical dimension → multiplicative structure → exponent expression
ranked_structures.mihur_scenario: Manipulate dimension labels, predict unit exponent, derive the expression, and compare against a geometric invariant.
ranked_structures.accessible_mve: Nonvisual dimension/face/area table paired with an optional keyboard geometry model.
ranked_structures.generator_oracle: Seeded dimension expressions; independent dimensional and exact arithmetic oracle.
ranked_structures.misconception_repair: Linear-versus-area/volume exponent errors route to unit-count reconstruction.
ranked_structures.unseen_transfer: Use square areas to justify a Pythagorean relationship without measuring the diagonal directly.

ranked_structures.variability: Large/small values; positive/negative exponent; coefficient below 1 or at/above 10; exact zeros/trailing zeros policy.
ranked_structures.cognitive_transition: place-value shifts → power-of-ten scale → normalized notation
ranked_structures.mihur_scenario: Move a decimal, track direction and distance, reject a non-normalized coefficient, and repair exponent compensation.
ranked_structures.accessible_mve: Keyboard place-value scale with textual coefficient interval and exponent ledger.
ranked_structures.generator_oracle: Seeded exact decimal/integer values; independent coefficient-range and exact-power reconstruction.
ranked_structures.misconception_repair: Wrong exponent sign and uncompensated coefficient shift use different direction/magnitude probes.
ranked_structures.unseen_transfer: Normalize a measurement from a new magnitude range and explain why its value is unchanged.

ranked_structures.variability: Coefficient products/quotients inside and outside normalized range; signed exponents; exact versus specified significant digits.
ranked_structures.cognitive_transition: operate separately on coefficients/powers → normalize → apply explicit precision rule
ranked_structures.mihur_scenario: Predict magnitude, operate on each component, normalize, then compare exact and policy-rounded forms.
ranked_structures.accessible_mve: Two-column coefficient/exponent workspace with nonvisual normalization step.
ranked_structures.generator_oracle: Exact Decimal/Fraction coefficient and integer exponent; independent normalization and rounding oracle.
ranked_structures.misconception_repair: Exponent multiplication and unnormalized-product errors route to separate component checks.
ranked_structures.unseen_transfer: Compare two rates expressed at different powers of ten and document the accepted form.

ranked_structures.variability: Integer/fraction/decimal display with exact rational value; signed solution; both sides; contextual units.
ranked_structures.cognitive_transition: candidate answer → evaluate each side independently → confirm or reject
ranked_structures.mihur_scenario: Fill an exact left/right evaluation table and explain what equality proves about the candidate.
ranked_structures.accessible_mve: Nonvisual substitution table with expression, replacement, exact value and equality status.
ranked_structures.generator_oracle: Independent Fraction evaluation of both sides, separate from solving formula.
ranked_structures.misconception_repair: Incorrect substitution order and decimal-rounding mismatch receive distinct exact-value probes.
ranked_structures.unseen_transfer: Audit a peer's proposed solution without reusing the peer's solving route.

ranked_structures.variability: Unknown start/rate/output/scale; geometry labels; realistic bounds; extra information; multiple representations.
ranked_structures.cognitive_transition: situation quantities → relationship choice → symbolic model → contextual validation
ranked_structures.mihur_scenario: Observe quantities, predict direct versus inverse structure, construct the model, solve, and test all labels/units.
ranked_structures.accessible_mve: Quantity-relation table and optional domain-specific visual, fully operable without dragging.
ranked_structures.generator_oracle: Seeded context data with separately derived model, exact result and constraint checks.
ranked_structures.misconception_repair: Operation-selection, unit and ignored-constraint errors route to different Socratic questions.
ranked_structures.unseen_transfer: Solve a structurally related problem in an unfamiliar context and defend why the same mathematics applies.
